_comment: Trigger vocabulary for the deterministic undo classifier (#6 Undo). Language data only -- no logic. Whole-message, whole-phrase matches, same convention as whoami_phrases.json -- 'delete that' is a phrase, not independently meaningful tokens. Deliberately generic (no material/expense-specific wording): this classifier's only job is to recognize the INTENT to undo something; runtime.reversal_query.find_latest_of_either_kind resolves WHAT that something is.
